rows.title: Default permissions
rows.desc: By default, Isonomic can read and edit files in its workspace. It can ask for additional access when needed.

rows.title: Full access
rows.desc: With full access, Isonomic can edit any file on your Mac and run commands with network access without asking. This significantly increases the risk of data loss, leaks, or unexpected behavior.

rows.title: Projectless chat folder
rows.desc: Where chats started outside a project store their data

rows.title: Default file open destination
rows.desc: Where files and folders open by default

rows.title: Show in menu bar
rows.desc: Keep Isonomic in the menu bar when the main window is closed

rows.title: Confirm before closing a window
rows.desc: Warn when a tab-close shortcut would close the window

rows.title: Full view by default
rows.desc: Open content tabs in full view in new chats

rows.title: Bottom panel
rows.desc: Show the bottom panel control in the app header

rows.title: Prevent sleep while running
rows.desc: Keep your Mac awake while Isonomic is running a task

rows.title: Start at login
rows.desc: Start the Isonomic engine when you log in

rows.title: Check for updates automatically
rows.desc: Download updates in the background and install on restart

rows.title: Plain text composer
rows.desc: Keep code, Markdown, and links as literal text while writing

rows.title: Send shortcut
rows.desc: Choose whether Enter sends or adds a new line

rows.title: Follow-up behavior
rows.desc: Queue follow-ups while Isonomic runs, or steer the current run. Press ⌘↩ to do the opposite once.

rows.title: Popout window hotkey
rows.desc: A global shortcut for the popout window. Leave unset to keep it off.

rows.title: Default to standalone chat
rows.desc: Start new chats outside any project
